note: Claude Code × Harbor arms (PRD; 4f). client_model: ANTHROPIC_MODEL in the trial container. main_model: what serves the main loop (auto = the router with the assessor; 4f's proxy rewrites the client model to auto in such an arm). hint: the x-router-hint the proxy stamps; null for every Claude Code arm (a pin hint would pin helper calls too; the body model is the pin). pack: the assessor pack (null: none). worst_model: the CapLedger's worst-case model per call. codex_ref: the Codex arm paired for κ. planning_usd: 0d's per-run planning cost at m = 1, the prior κ before the pilot. Adding an arm before stage 1 is an edit of this file, then shardplan derive --force.
